run_tools_command: run the hermes tools command to configure toolsets per platform with provider-aware setup
configure_mcp_tools_interactive: configure MCP server tools interactively by probing available tools and toggling them on or off
tools_disable_enable_command: enable or disable specific toolsets and MCP tools for a platform via argparse CLI arguments
summarize_platform_toolset_summary: summarize enabled toolsets per platform from the loaded configuration dictionary
review_tools_config_constants: review the CONFIGURABLE_TOOLSETS, TOOL_CATEGORIES, and PLATFORMS constants that define available tool configuration options
